subject: Literature
title: Iranian Writers Under Censorship
description: One-minute skill: Iranian Writers Under Censorship.

hook.text: After Iran's 1979 revolution, writers faced a new censorship bureau that reviewed every book before publication.

buildup.text: Authors had to submit manuscripts to the Ministry of Culture, which deleted passages or banned entire works.

discovery.text: Iranian writers developed an art of coded language, hiding political criticism inside metaphor, poetry, and allegory.

twist.text: In the 1990s, several dissident writers were murdered in what became known as the Chain Murders of intellectuals.

climax.text: Iranian literature thrived in exile, with banned authors publishing abroad and their works smuggled back into the country.

punchline.text: Censorship taught writers to hide revolution inside metaphor.

quiz.question: How did Iranian writers cope with censorship after the 1979 revolution?
options: They developed coded language and metaphor to hide political criticism
